services.name: private event
services.desc: The back of the Urban Beer Garden is open and ready to welcome you for your next private gathering! Our event space is behind the Urban Beer Garden in our old production space. Its private entrance is on Woodland Park Ave N and can easily accommodate 75 seated or up to 150 mingling. Hang out with your closest friends under the string lights with a cold beer in hand. Open the garage door to get a feel of the outdoors, or keep it closed for a more intimate atmosphere. Event hosts may select their beverages from our rotating tap list. We also have local cider and several non-alcoholic options, including our very own Non-Alcoholic Beer and Hoppy Spritz. We are a BYOF (bring your own food)
